gloss: to recover; to rally; to improve

definitions.gloss: to recover; to rally; to pick up
definitions.explanation: to return to a better state after a decline, especially regarding health, weather, or conditions

examples.japanese: {病状|びょうじょう}が{持|も}ち{直|なお}した。
{天気|てんき}が{持|も}ち{直|なお}してきた。
{株価|かぶか}がやっと{持|も}ち{直|なお}しつつある。
examples.english: Stock prices are finally starting to recover.

notes:
USAGE:
- {病状|びょうじょう}が{持|も}ち{直|なお}す (condition improves)
- {天気|てんき}が{持|も}ち{直|なお}す (weather improves)
- {景気|けいき}が{持|も}ち{直|なお}す (economy recovers)

NUANCE:
Implies gradual recovery from a difficult situation. Often used for health, weather, and economic conditions.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})

RELATED:
- {盛|も}り{返|かえ}す (to rally - similar, more active)
- {回復|かいふく}する (to recover - more formal)
- {持|も}つ (to hold - base verb)
